goal: A developer can run skillz eval to get generated positive and negative trigger tests and behavioural cases for a skill, deterministic offline grades, weak areas with concrete improvement proposals, and an opt-in with-skill versus no-skill baseline run through the claude or codex CLI that records skipped when no runner is available

plan.goal: Deterministic case generation, offline lexical-overlap matcher and grading, and weak-area improvement proposals in evalcases.py, tested on well-described and vague fixture specs

Opt-in baseline runner in runner.py: Runner protocol, ClaudeRunner and CodexRunner over subprocess with timeout, call-time shutil.which detection, marker grading, with/without-skill baseline and skipped: no runner, tested with fake runners only

skillz eval subcommand in evaluate.py (spec load with frontmatter fallback, cases, offline grades, optional baseline, cases.json/eval.json/eval.md under .factory) wired into cli.py with end-to-end tests; depends on eval-cases and baseline-runner
